data.markdown:
# Log10x POC: local source (file)

_Pulled 9.7K log lines (2.19 MB) across 16 files. Span: 22 minutes (1,319 s), from the first to the last record timestamp (2026-10-15T10:33:48.031Z to 2026-10-15T10:55:47.006Z; 7,118 of 9,676 sampled records carry one)._

## Sample composition

These files produced the bytes in the sample. **Confirm this looks like your production mix before trusting the projection**: if 70% of your real-prod bytes come from a service that is NOT in this list, the savings projection is meaningless to you. Widen `paths` or raise `max_pods` (the file cap) if anything looks off.

| File | Bytes | Lines | % of sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| `otel-collector` | 1.2 MB | 4.0K | 55% |
| `frontend` | 0.386 MB | 1.4K | 18% |
| `kafka` | 0.214 MB | 995 | 10% |
| `cart` | 0.102 MB | 1.6K | 5% |
| `accounting` | 52.7 KB | 158 | 2% |
| `payment` | 52.3 KB | 158 | 2% |
| `shipping` | 42.6 KB | 242 | 2% |
| `recommendation` | 38.1 KB | 124 | 2% |
| `ad` | 20.9 KB | 122 | 1.0% |
| `astronomy-db` | 19.6 KB | 268 | 0.9% |
| _(6 more)_ | 57.1 KB | - | 3% |

## Projected savings at default rates

_Rates: the vendor's list price where it sells logs per GB, and a per-GB default, marked "default rate", where it bills in other units or publishes no per-GB price. Pass `effective_ingest_per_gb` on `log10x_estimate_savings` or `log10x_savings` once your real $/GB is known to convert these projections into a customer-specific quote._

If your full ingest mix matches this sample, ~76% of your byte volume is non-error high-frequency patterns: candidates for compacting, tiering down or offloading, each of which keeps every line.

**Projected daily ingest** (extrapolated from sample): 0.143 GB.

_The daily projection spreads the files' bytes over their span, read from the record timestamps._

_These are list prices and default rates, not predictions of your specific bill: use them to size the order of magnitude, not to negotiate with procurement._

| Log analyzer | Rate | Annual cost | Annual savings |
|---|---|---|---|
| Datadog | $2.50/GB (default rate, a blend of Datadog's two meters, which datadoghq.com/pricing/list gives as $0.10 per GB ingested and $2.50 per million events indexed at 30-day retention, billed annually) | $122 | $92 |
| Splunk | $6.00/GB (default rate, not a Splunk list price) | $292 | $222 |
| CloudWatch Logs | $0.50/GB (ingestion + first-month storage) | $24 | $18 |
| Azure Monitor | $2.30/GB (Analytics tier ingest, list price) | $112 | $85 |
| Sumo Logic | $2.50/GB (default rate, not a Sumo Logic list price) | $122 | $92 |
| Elasticsearch | $1.00/GB (default rate, an estimate of self-managed infrastructure per GB) | $49 | $37 |
| Coralogix | $1.15/GB (Frequent Search (High) priority, list price) | $56 | $42 |
| Elastic Cloud Serverless | $0.07/GB (Logs Essentials ingest floor; retention billed separately) | $3.4 | $2.6 |
| OpenSearch | $0.10/GB (self-hosted compute baseline (no canonical list rate)) | $4.9 | $3.7 |

## Top patterns in the sample

| # | Identity | Events | % | Bytes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `$(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z') info Traces {"resource": {"…` | 1.1K | 13% | 0.327 MB |
| 2 | `$(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z') info Metrics {"resource": {…` | 968 | 12% | 0.327 MB |
| 3 | `$(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z') info Logs {"resource": {"se…` | 801 | 10% | 0.25 MB |
| 4 | `{"level":$,"time":$(+%s),"pid":$,"hostname":"$","trace_id":…` | 541 | 6% | 0.156 MB |
| 5 | `$(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z') info Logs {"resource": {"se…` | 509 | 6% | 0.159 MB |
| 6 | `info: cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore[$] GetCartAsync called…` | 341 | 4% | 41.6 KB |
| 7 | `{"level":$,"time":$(+%s),"pid":$,"hostname":"$","trace_id":…` | 262 | 3% | 72 KB |
| 8 | `::$ - - [$(dd/MMM/yyyy:HH:mm:ss Z)] "GET // HTTP//$1.$1" $ …` | 261 | 3% | 19.3 KB |
| 9 | `$(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z') info Traces {"resource": {"…` | 259 | 3% | 80.5 KB |
| 10 | `$(yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS) $ [$] FATAL: role "root" does no…` | 258 | 3% | 17.8 KB |

_For native stack exclusion configs, paste-ready Receiver YAML, and the full 9-section report, run `log10x_poc_from_siem` once you have credentials available._

## Notes
- wrapped-JSON normalization applied: 9676 of 9676 lines decoded; analysed bytes count the unwrapped payload, raw file size is 4113038 bytes.

_This POC read local files on a machine with network access. The same POC runs with no network at all. To run it offline, see `actions[]` for `log10x_emit_sample_plan`, or the [offline POC guide](https://github.com/log-10x/log10x-mcp/blob/main/docs/fenced-poc.md)._

**Fleet default.** Any service not listed: a statement above 6,084 lines a day goes to the offload bucket. Up to 1,800 lines a day of every statement always reach Standard on each node. To install it, call `log10x_advise_install` with the `fleet_default` from this result and `log_destination: "datadog"`.

## Projected commitment: local (file sample)

- **Target reduction**: 70% of the volume out of the Standard index
- **Projected max achievable**: 72.9% of the volume out of the Standard index (feasible)
- **Datadog Flex**: Moves 5,977 events (0 GB) a month out of the Standard index into Datadog Flex Logs. Standard indexing avoided: $0.01/mo at $1.70 per million events (15-day retention). Flex Starter added: $0.01/mo at $0.60 per million events stored per month, compute included, held 3 months (the size Datadog recommends below 10 billion events stored). Datadog list prices and Flex Logs docs, read 2026-10-13.
- **Sample bytes analyzed**: 2.19 MB
- **Span**: 22 minutes (1,319 s), from the first to the last record timestamp (2026-10-15T10:33:48.031Z to 2026-10-15T10:55:47.006Z; 7,118 of 9,676 sampled records carry one).

### Next step

1. Re-run `log10x_poc_from_siem_submit` once log-analyzer credentials are available: the stack path produces the per-pattern action plan + native exclusion configs.
2. Run `log10x_advise_install` to provision the Receiver in your forwarder pipeline.

_This is a PRE-DEPLOY projection from a local file sample. Local-source feasibility carries higher uncertainty than the stack-attached path because the sample may not cover CloudTrail / ALB / VM-hosted apps the analyzer also ingests._
